shots.title: Your study journey, connected
shots.narration: Before studying abroad, every student faces the same question: can I afford the whole journey? This is StudyFlow.

shots.title: One full-course total
shots.narration: Your first answer brings tuition, living costs and essential expenses into one full-course total.

shots.title: Transparent assumptions
shots.narration: Each line distinguishes sourced fees from estimates, so you can see what the total depends on.

shots.title: Four schools, one view
shots.narration: With four universities side by side, course length and total cost become easier to compare.

shots.title: Costs in your currency
shots.narration: The same comparison is available in Thai baht and Chinese yuan,

shots.title: A shared comparison
shots.narration: or US dollars, using reference exchange rates.

shots.title: Known funds, clear gap
shots.narration: Your declared savings carry into a saved plan, making the funding gap clear. The borrowing ceiling is simulated, not a bank offer.

shots.title: Flexible estimates
shots.narration: If an assumption changes, updating one fee revises the estimate.

shots.title: Costs mapped to dates
shots.narration: The forecast then connects those costs to payment dates and sources.

shots.title: Repayment choices
shots.narration: For the gap that remains, custom and commercial loan examples show different repayment paths.

shots.title: Support during study
shots.narration: One defers principal during study, with the full schedule available.

shots.title: A plan for repayment
shots.narration: Here, we choose twenty thousand baht over sixty months, with principal and interest paid from the start.

shots.title: Your confirmed application
shots.narration: Once the student confirms the plan, it becomes a simulated loan application.

shots.title: Clear document status
shots.narration: The checklist records demo declarations; it does not verify uploaded documents.

shots.title: Consent before signing
shots.narration: A separate signing step makes consent and the school recipient explicit.

shots.title: Funding goes to the school
shots.narration: The signed agreement schedules payments directly to the school's account, verified within this simulation, without adding loan funds to the student's wallet.

shots.title: Support from family
shots.narration: Family support covers another part of the plan: first-month housing.

shots.title: A promise stays a promise
shots.narration: A private link lets a family member confirm the promise, while the wallet stays unchanged.

shots.title: Receipt updates the wallet
shots.narration: Only when the operator records a simulated receipt does the wallet gain six thousand five hundred baht.

shots.title: Preparation in one place
shots.narration: Preparation stays in the same conversation. A dated reminder can be acknowledged, then completed.

shots.title: Enrollment by confirmation
shots.narration: When registration is finished, the student explicitly confirms enrollment.

shots.title: Ready for student life
shots.narration: That opens daily-life tools; the date alone neither enrolls the student nor pays a bill.

shots.title: A budget you can follow
shots.narration: A monthly budget of six thousand baht keeps upcoming payments and shortfalls in view.

shots.title: Lunch, recorded naturally
shots.narration: Just tell StudyFlow what you spent on lunch. It records the expense and updates your remaining budget.

shots.title: An easy correction
shots.narration: Made a mistake? Undoing the entry restores the budget immediately.

shots.title: Balances by currency
shots.narration: Separate currency balances make spending easier to follow. All funds shown here come from simulated top-ups and receipts.

shots.title: A proposal before an exchange
shots.narration: For an exchange, the assistant compares quotes and prepares a proposal, awaiting your approval.

shots.title: A wrong password stops here
shots.narration: A wrong password stops the action and leaves balances unchanged.

shots.title: An authorized conversion
shots.narration: With the correct password and confirmation, five hundred yuan is converted into baht.

shots.title: Routes before commitment
shots.narration: The same principle applies to remittances: routes, fees and arrival estimates come before commitment.

shots.title: A transfer you can track
shots.narration: Once confirmed, the transfer debits the source balance and creates an order you can track.

shots.title: A clear tuition shortfall
shots.narration: When tuition is due, the Pay tab separates your own bills from those covered by the loan.

shots.title: Exactly the missing amount
shots.narration: A visible shortfall leads to a top-up for exactly the missing amount.

shots.title: Consent before payment
shots.narration: Reviewing the payee and entering the password authorizes payment.

shots.title: A bill paid once
shots.narration: The bill is marked paid, while a loan-covered bill is protected against a duplicate charge.

shots.title: Repayment under your control
shots.narration: Repayment follows the same consent flow. We advance the demo date, then authorize the first installment with a password.

shots.title: A visible repayment history
shots.narration: The paid installment appears in the loan history.

shots.title: Credit for smaller bills
shots.narration: For smaller bills, the fixed demo credit line provides funds repayable within thirty days.

shots.title: Repayment from the wallet
shots.narration: Repaying that credit requires a password and debits the simulated wallet.

shots.title: Available credit restored
shots.narration: The available line is restored, with an on-time record when repayment meets the due date.

shots.title: Limits enforced by the server
shots.narration: These safeguards also set boundaries. An over-limit transfer is blocked without operator approval, even with the correct password.

shots.title: A traceable activity record
shots.narration: The audit trail records authorization attempts and completed actions.

shots.title: Your internal on-time record
shots.narration: Eligible payments build StudyFlow's internal on-time record, rather than an external credit score.

shots.title: A statement anyone can check
shots.narration: A signed statement can be checked by a separate visitor without logging in.

shots.title: Changes are detected
shots.narration: Changing its contents makes verification fail.

shots.title: Clear costs. User control.
shots.narration: From the first cost comparison to student life, StudyFlow keeps decisions connected: live AI proposes, the server enforces, and the student authorizes.

paragraphs.text: These safeguards also set boundaries. An over-limit transfer is blocked without operator approval, even with the correct password. A signed statement can be checked by a separate visitor without logging in. Changing its contents makes verification fail.
